subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as core TUI config, as a plugin status-provider SDK plus TUI render seam, or rejected in favor of existing /status and /usage surfaces?
rationale: The request crosses public TUI config, provider auth/usage calls, background caching, and Plugin SDK boundaries, so automation should not choose the long-term product/API contract.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Use a generic PluginStatusProvider-style seam and decide TUI ordering, truncation, caching, and security policy before adding provider-specific fields.

options.title: Core footer template config
options.body: Add a first-class TUI footer template/config contract and accept the public config, migration, and compatibility burden.

options.title: Keep existing surfaces
options.body: Declare /status, /usage, CLI status, and external plugins as the supported cost/quota surfaces and close persistent footer customization as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Use a generic PluginStatusProvider-style seam and decide TUI ordering, truncation, caching, and security policy before adding provider-specific fields.

likelyOwner.reason: History and related discussion tie this decision to provider-usage/status and plugin/API product boundaries.
